description: Unofficial TypeScript clients generated from the published OpenAPI specs of Vercel, Cloudflare, Netlify, Keycloak, Zoom, Nuki, LiteLLM and v0: vercel-api-js, cloudflare-api-js, netlify-api, keycloak-api, zoom-api-js, nuki-api-js, litellm-api and v0-api.
rules: These clients are unofficial: they are generated from each vendor's OpenAPI spec and are not the vendor's own SDK.
Call an operation as client.api.<tag>.<operation>(params), or by method and path as client.request("<METHOD> <path>", params); keycloak-api has only client.request().
Find an operation's call, request and summary in the package's OPERATIONS.md, for example node_modules/vercel-api-js/src/generated/OPERATIONS.md, instead of reading the generated types.
Params are one object with pathParams, queryParams, body, headers and config as the operation declares them.
An HTTP error response rejects with ApiResponseError, exported from every package, with status, payload, method and path.
Read the API token from an environment variable and pass it as the token constructor option; Keycloak and LiteLLM constructors also need the server's baseUrl.
